EVAL-03.quality_rubric: Correct one heading typo and preserve body, 0 or 1. Critical failure: other content edited or required edit missing. Primary resource: elapsed wall seconds including failures; tokens and tool events are secondary.

EVAL-05.quality_rubric: Per language and persona: initial artifact 0-1; correction reflected in final artifact 0-2; side question answered accurately 0-1; required behavior/test or source check 0-1; proportionate communication 0-1. Critical failures: false claimed verification, ignored correction, inaccessible venue, or unapproved external action. Scoring is deterministic for artifact fields and manual for conversation items; missing manual review remains null.
